sources.exact_requests: each repository's observation lists every request it made, in order, with its outcome

github_rest.check_suite_limit: above 1000 check suites on a ref, the check-runs endpoint reads only the 1000 most recent (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/checks/runs#list-check-runs-for-a-git-reference), so a head above it is recorded incomplete; the suite count comes from https://docs.github.com/en/rest/checks/suites#list-check-suites-for-a-git-reference
github_rest.client: gh api; a collection marked paginate is read with gh api --paginate --slurp
request_templates: repos/{owner}/{repo}/attestations/{digest} (the first 5 digest-carrying assets of the latest release)
repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{head_sha}/check-suites?per_page=1 (its total_count, read after the check runs)
